name: g4_verdict_gse178341
purpose: G4 answered on the real cohort. execution_plan.md section 5: fewer than 50% of patients below the mature-cell positivity threshold.
population: matched patients only (decision #19); matched = observed in both tissues
headline: best4 fails 28/28 on BOTH axes, CI [0.879, 1.000] - a resolvable FAIL. Every other rung is indeterminate at n=28: the interval contains the 0.50 line whichever side the point estimate falls.
why_no_single_number: The mature population is defined by the rung, so the fraction below the cutpoint is too. One number would be picking a rung and calling it the cohort.
consequence: execution_plan.md section 5, G4 fail: non-identifiability with diagnostics becomes the headline result, not a caveat.

caveats.labels: W1's labeller. Its depth floor works (median |rho| 0.13 vs -0.92 on Lee) but the arms are not depth-matched on 20 of 32 patients; 17 of 256 patient-axis-rung combinations trip both conditions, all at lineage or crypt_position. best4 is the LEAST affected rung (median |rho| 0.069), so the resolvable FAIL is the most robust number here.
caveats.rung_degeneracy: lineage and crypt_position are the same partition on most patients (issue #42), which is why they return identical verdicts on stem_pole.
caveats.cutpoint_is_provisional: The intrinsic cutpoint has not been recalibrated on real cells (handoff task 6).

SUPERSEDED: This table silently used the FILTERED tumour arm only. g4_over_rungs did not group by tumour_arm, so its per-patient dedup collapsed two arm definitions and .first() took filtered in 224 of 224 combinations by file order. Superseded by results/2026-08-28_0be41e6/g4_verdict_gse178341_by_arm.parquet and its amendment-1 reduction. Gate memo section 17.1. The best4 FAIL survives under both arms; every other row does not.
